package shop

import (
	"context"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

// The icons of icons.go, as TestSSRDrawsItsIconsAndYours writes it: share-2
// of the project's own, chevron-left none, mine a whole <svg>.
func TestOwnIcons(t *testing.T) {
	draw := func(name string) string {
		var b strings.Builder
		if err := Icon(name).Render(context.Background(), &b); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		return b.String()
	}
	var share strings.Builder
	if err := Share("https://loja.com", "Loja").Render(context.Background(), &share); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if got := share.String(); !strings.Contains(got, `viewBox="0 0 24 24"`) || !strings.Contains(got, `<path d="M1 1h2"/>`) {
		t.Errorf("Share draws not the project's icon: %s", got)
	}
	if got := draw("search"); !strings.Contains(got, `r="8"`) {
		t.Errorf("search: %q", got)
	}
	if got := draw("mine"); got != `<svg id="mine"></svg>` {
		t.Errorf("mine: %q", got)
	}
	if got := draw("chevron-left") + draw("no-such-icon"); got != "" {
		t.Errorf("drawn: %q", got)
	}
}
